summary: Trinity Biotech PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting that it agreed with lender Perceptive Credit Holdings III, LP to capitalize May 2026 interest payable under its credit agreement, adding it to the principal balance. Perceptive also granted a limited waiver for June 2026 regarding Section 8.15 of the credit agreement. The filing is an amendment to a credit facility, not a special situation. This non-US filing is the equivalent of an 8-K for material definitive agreements. No transaction or corporate action is involved. Watch for covenant compliance and refinancing risk.
